env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^const map shared ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constmap

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/constmap/left"
	"example.com/constmap/owner"
	"example.com/constmap/right"
)

func main() {
	owned := owner.DeclaredFromOwner()
	fromLeft := left.Declared()
	fromRight := right.Declared()
	fromLeft[0] = 90
	if (owned[0] ?? -1) != 90 || (fromRight[0] ?? -1) != 90 || owner.DeclaredValue(0) != 51 {
		panic("package const map is not shared across instantiations")
	}
	fmt.Println("const map shared ok")
}

-- m/owner/owner.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package owner

import "comptime"

type Shared struct{ N int }
type Distinct struct{ N int }

const DeclaredTable = map[int]int{1: 61, 0: 51}

func DeclaredFromOwner() map[int]int {
	var materialized map[int]int = DeclaredTable
	return materialized
}

func Declared[T any]() map[int]int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		var materialized map[int]int = DeclaredTable
		return materialized
	}
	return map[int]int{}
}

func DeclaredValue(key int) int { return DeclaredTable[key] ?? -1 }

-- m/left/left.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package left

import "example.com/constmap/owner"

func Declared() map[int]int { return owner.Declared[owner.Shared]() }

-- m/right/right.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package right

import "example.com/constmap/owner"

func Declared() map[int]int { return owner.Declared[owner.Distinct]() }
